seo.title: Social Butterfly Communications | Turn Conversations into Customers
seo.description: Turn conversations into customers. Strategic social media services to turn interest into action: strategy + development, creation + execution, and advertising + insights.

hero.subhead: Strategic Social Media Services to Turn Interest into Action.

banner: Paid and Organic Social Media Strategy

about.caption: Meghan Blackford, Owner.
about.paragraph1: As our namesake implies, we know how to build buzz around products, services and special events and keep the conversation going with the right people. We tailor our social media services to your goals, whether you need a single campaign or someone to manage it all.
about.paragraph2: From strategy and copywriting to paid advertising, we create content that gives new audiences a reason to stop scrolling, get curious and reach out.
about.photoAlt: Meghan Blackford, owner of Social Butterfly Communications

services.title: Strategy + Development
services.tagline: Bring your brand to life with a social media presence that stands out.
services.body: Through competitive analysis, audience research and brand positioning, we identify what sets your business apart. Then we develop content themes, platform recommendations and campaign plans that turn those insights into a clear social media strategy.

services.title: Creation + Execution
services.tagline: Spark a connection with prospective customers.
services.body: Give your audience a reason to stop scrolling. We create compelling graphics, videos and copy that capture your brand’s personality with clear calls-to-action. Then, we handle scheduling, publishing and community engagement to keep the conversation flowing.

services.title: Advertising + Insights
services.tagline: Test new audiences and optimize content performance.
services.body: Turn interest into action with targeted social advertising. We develop creative, manage campaigns and track performance to refine your message, optimize your budget and support your business goals.

approach.paragraph1: We believe that social media should constantly evolve, just as technology does. 99 percent of the time, what worked last year – or last month – will yield less effective results in today’s marketplace. For this reason, we push ourselves to innovate new ways to spark curiosity and foster relationships.
approach.paragraph2: Our focus on research and analysis contributes to content strategies that are rooted in measurable results. All too often, what separates well-executed campaigns from poorly performing content is an effective paid promotion strategy. This is why discovery, research and metrics are at the heart of our approach.
